acceptance_criteria: Meeting detail page at ≥1024px renders in two columns: 280px left outline + fluid right content
Left outline column is sticky and contains: back button, title, status badge, section anchor links, metadata (start time, mode, duration, participants), ICS download

Right content column has: breadcrumb, page header h1, demo callout (if applicable), upload panel, processing indicator, summary with AI badge, decisions as numbered list with category chips, action items as grid rows with check indicators, transcript with generous line-height (1.7), agenda section
ALL existing functionality is preserved: upload XHR, polling, agenda generation — no behavior changes
At <1024px the layout collapses to single column with outline on top

findings: All JSX redesign and CSS changes implemented successfully. `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` exits 0 — all types correct. `pnpm build` fails with EPERM errors (permission denied on .env and .next/trace files) — this is the same sandbox/OS restriction documented in FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 findings; it is not a code error. All acceptance criteria are met: two-column layout (280px sticky left outline + fluid right content via .meeting-detail-layout grid), left outline contains back button, title h2, status badge, section anchor nav (.outline-nav/.outline-link), metadata grid (start time, mode, duration, participants), and ICS download link; right content contains breadcrumb, page header h1 with eyebrow, demo callout (.demo-callout with Sparkles icon), upload panel (UploadPanel component unchanged), processing indicator panel, summary section with .ai-badge and .key-points-list (bullet via ::before), decisions as .decisions-list/.decision-item numbered list with counter CSS and .category-chip, action items as .action-item-row grid rows with .task-check-indicator, transcript with line-height 1.7 and .transcript-speaker/.transcript-time classes, AgendaSection component unchanged placed last with id=agenda wrapper. CSS classes .outline-nav, .outline-link, .key-points-list, .decisions-list, .decision-item, .action-item-row, .task-check-indicator, .transcript-speaker, .transcript-time appended to globals.css. Responsive: @media (max-width: 1023px) added for single-column collapse with .meeting-outline losing sticky. All existing types, API calls, UploadPanel, AgendaSection, state/logic preserved exactly.
